en: Codex quota panels now prioritize the official ordinary-usage permission and preserve reported restriction reasons. A full percentage window alone no longer labels an account exhausted; missing permission remains unconfirmed. Member and owner workspace limits are distinguished.

Five-hour windows are omitted only for officially reported Pro plan classifications, including the account-plan fallback. Team and Business accounts are not treated as Pro based on their names. Remaining reset times are displayed directly from provider timestamps; global announcements never substitute for account readings.

Official availability and restriction fields survive display-cache reloads. Cached readings require refresh; actual service errors still govern execution and account relay. No automatic purchases, reset redemption or paid API fallback were added.
zh: Codex 额度面板优先显示官方普通用量可用状态，保留实际阻塞原因；不再仅凭窗口百分比已满就标记账号已用完，缺失可用状态明确显示尚未确认，并区分工作区成员与总额度限制。
只对官方明确返回的 Pro 套餐类型移除五小时窗口，支持账号套餐字段回退；不会依据名称把团队或 Business 账号当作 Pro。恢复时间直接显示官方时间戳，不用全局公告推算个人账号恢复日期。
官方可用状态与限制字段随显示缓存保存；缓存记录需刷新，真实执行错误仍决定失败与账号接续。本次未增加自动购买、重置卡兑换或付费 API 回退。
